claims.text: The CoVoST dataset was built using validated voice clips from the Common Voice corpus, which are recorded by contributors reading from a bank of donated sentences.
Transcripts were sent to professional translators for translation, ensuring quality and accuracy in the dataset.
The dataset also includes evaluation data derived from the Tatoeba corpus, which provides aligned sentences across multiple languages.
